This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在古代：在古代住在一起，An era is a time expression, so it should be introduced with 在古代 rather than used as the location after 住在. [rule: time_expression]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 常常生病了：常常生病，A habitual action or state with 常常 uses the zero particle, not completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with his name and a full noun phrase rather than using only the name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们去很多不一样的地方：他们去了很多不一样的地方，This is a completed narrative action, so the verb needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “住在古代” can correctly mean living in ancient times; the proposed wording unnecessarily changes the meaning to living together.
With habitual 常常, 生病 should not take completed-action 了.
As 神农 is first introduced here, the teacher requires a fuller introduction such as “一个叫神农的人”.
The trip to the various places is a completed narrative event, so 去 needs 了.
